main_text.p: adiectiui neutri generis, singularis ac pluralis numeri, et dualis numerus in to tum, similes sunt suis masculinis.
main_text.head: DE ARTICVLO CAP. I.
main_text.p: ArticulusARTICVLI diiuiduntur in praepositiuos, & subiunctiuos: caret uocatiuis, & flectuntur sic.
main_text.head: Praepositiui Masculini.
main_text.p: Mascul.Praepositiui masculini singulares, nominatiuo ὁ, genitiuo τοῦ, datiuo τῷ, accusatiuo τὸν. Duales, nominatiuo & accusatiuo τώ, genitiuo & datiuo τοῖν. Plurales, nominatiuo οἱ, genitiuo τῶν, datiuo τοῖς, accusatiuo τοὺς.
main_text.head: Foeminini.
main_text.p: Foemin.Foeminini singulares, ἡ, τῆς, τῇ, τὴν. Dual. τὰ τᾶιν. Plural, αἱ, τῶν, ταῖς, τὰς.
main_text.head: Neutri.
main_text.p: Neutr.Neutri singulares, τὸ, τοῦ, τῷ, τό. Dual, τώ, τοῖν. Plural, τά, τῶν, τοῖς, τά.
main_text.head: Canon.
main_text.p: ὁ cũ tenui aduerbiũ est.Ex praepositiuis subiunctiui fiunt, litera ς ipsi ὁ subnexa, & reliquis ablata ta

page.notes: Marginal note beside the Canon paragraph reads "ὁ cũ tenui aduerbiũ est." Greek accents and breathings in the paragraphs are approximated where the print is small; the Greek forms for the article may be doubtful. Woodcut initial A at the start of the chapter.
